whatsNew:
Photos on their way

When someone sends you a photo or file, its message can reach you a few seconds before the file does. It used to show as an empty bubble, and the chat list said "No messages yet". Now the bubble says "Photo or file on its way…" and turns into the photo as soon as it arrives, and the chat list says "Attachment". If it never arrives (the sender's upload failed and wasn't retried), the bubble says so after half an hour.

The chat list also names what you just sent in your own language right away.

On the web, reloading or closing the page while a photo or file is still uploading now asks first, so an upload isn't lost by accident.

Please check

- Ask someone to send you a large photo and watch the bubble while it arrives.
- Send a photo and look at the chat list while it uploads.
